answer: One concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted grading seats gated by continuous work history. Agents must keep a shale-thin but unbroken streak of attested answers; a sudden swarm of empty accounts cannot leapfrog into power. Publish a public beacon of each identity's settled grades and slash bonded stake when a panel detects copy-paste rings. Over time the productive orchard of real miners crowds out throwaway personas because only sustained contribution unlocks seats.
